reviews.title: Has Become VERY Inaccurate
reviews.text:
I’m not kidding.  I’ve used this app for years and was very satisfied.  Lately, it just drops hundreds of steps on numerous occasions.  It’s happened too many times in the past days and weeks.
Just yesterday, I walked 16,160 steps by the time I went to bed.
I got up for a drink of water after Midnight and this app now said yesterday’s steps had been 15,288 steps.
It had dropped me from 7.0 miles to 6.6 miles.
This is just one time too many that it had pulled this stunt.
If my bank did this, I’d be calling the Authorities and pulling my money out.
I’m very discouraged and I AM DONE.
I’m deleting this app and will download another.
It was nice for years, but I’m out of here.
Buh-Bye!
